AdminAnalysisQueries.VisualizationHelp: Changing the visualization replaces this JSON with an editable example template. Adjust column names, bounds, thresholds and mappings to your query. Optional settings as an object ({{}} keeps defaults): color, minimum/maximum, decimals, cellDisplay (Text, ColorText, ColorBackground, StatusIcon), wrapText, thresholds, valueMappings and columns. For icon-only table cells, StatusIcon requires statusIcons with mappings (value, text as symbol, color), unknownSymbol and unknownColor. Override metadata columns with cellDisplay: Text. For Stat: statTitleFontSize and statValueFontSize (8-72 pixels). Colors: green, red, yellow, orange, blue, purple, gray, teal or #RRGGBB. Thresholds must be increasing. Settings are validated and published with the query.
AdminAnalysisQueries.KqlHelp: System-scoped queries must use _SelectedSystems. Workspace-wide queries must use _TimePeriod and do not require a Computer column. Statistics return Series, numeric or null Value (optional Dimension/Unit). Tables keep all columns; configure StatusIcon and statusIcons in visualization JSON for icon-only cells, or add ColumnName__Status (OK/Warning/Error/Unknown) for legacy icons beside text. Visualization columns match table column names, or Dimension/Series for charts/statistics.

Return Target and a positive integer count_, for example: where Target !in~ (_InventoryComputers) | summarize count() by Target. Each unknown target has its own alert. A successful complete result without that target, or its addition to Inventory, resolves its alert; query errors do not. No rows means no unknown targets. Do not use _SelectedSystems.

AdminScheduledQueries.EventFieldsHelp: Each event example filters one EventID and includes EventId, Users (JSON array), UnparsedEvents and UsersTruncated as alert details. Account filtering is already applied during collection. XML Data indices: 4624 = 5; 4768/4769 = 0; 5136 = 3; 4794 = 1; 4724/4736 = actor 4 changes account 0. Verify these positions against your collected EventData.
AdminScheduledQueries.EventDataHelp: The event count is measured only when Security events were observed; an empty telemetry window returns null, not zero. The account list shows at most {0} distinct entries. Missing account fields and truncated lists are reported explicitly. AdminScheduledQueries.SystemKqlHelp: Use _SelectedSystems, _WindowStart (inclusive) and _WindowEnd (exclusive). Return Series = Computer and one numeric or null Value per computer. Aggregate inside the KQL; the examples use the average over the complete window, not five consecutive threshold breaches. No row or a null value means No data.

FreeKql.Examples.ExpandColumns: Expand an array into multiple columns
FreeKql.Examples.Query.Tables:
search *
| summarize count() by $table
| sort by $table
FreeKql.Examples.Query.ExpandRows:
DCDiagData_CL
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, Status) by Computer
| extend Tests = todynamic(Status)
| mv-expand Test = bag_keys(Tests)
| extend TestName = tostring(Test)
| project Timestamp = TimeGenerated, Computer, TestName,Result = tostring(Tests[TestName])
| order by Result asc, Computer, TestName asc
FreeKql.Examples.Query.ExpandColumns:
DCDiagData_CL
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, Status) by Computer
| project Computer, Timestamp = TimeGenerated, Tests = todynamic(Status)
| evaluate bag_unpack(Tests, "")
| order by Computer asc
FreeKql.Examples.Query.Join:
let ReplData = DCReplicationData_CL
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Computer = SourceDSA, DestDSA, NC
| where Source == "showrepl_INFO"
| summarize
    NumberOfFailures = sum(tolong(NumberOfFailures)),
    LastObservation = max(TimeGenerated)
    by Computer
| order by NumberOfFailures desc, Computer asc;
DCDiagData_CL
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, Status) by Computer
| project Computer, Timestamp = TimeGenerated, Tests = todynamic(Status)
| evaluate bag_unpack(Tests, "")
| order by Computer asc
| join ReplData on Computer
